name: Kite Corsair
lore: A sky smuggler riding a patched sail. Movement builds momentum and banks gradually; release movement to brake. The small blue gauge shows how much extra force your next Sail Needle carries.

primary.name: Sail Needle
primary.description: Fire a fast wind needle for 18 damage, plus up to 12 more from your actual gliding speed. The first foe or wall stops it.

secondary.name: Windlass Swing
secondary.description: Hold secondary to orbit your aimed anchor, accelerating up to 480 speed. Release to launch toward your current aim. Maximum hold 4s; walls stop the orbit. Each foe takes 28 damage once.

special.name: Storm Delivery
special.description: Three parachute parcels land around your aim point after staggered warnings. Each blasts for 42 and pushes foes away. Their wind pads grant allies 20% speed for 1.5s while crossed.

passive: Updraft Reserve: Completing Windlass Swing grants 15% damage reduction for 2s.

technique.name: Long Tack
technique.description: Windlass Swing reaches 480 instead of 360, but deals 18 instead of 28 damage.

final_technique.name: Headwind Harpoon
final_technique.description: Replace momentum-powered needles with 26-damage harpoons. They pull foes slightly and slow them for 1.5s, but fire more slowly and gain no movement damage.

attack.name: Headwind Harpoon
attack.description: Fire a harpoon for 26 damage, pulling a hit foe 35 toward you and slowing it by 40% for 1.5s. No momentum bonus.
